pages.title: Cute Unicorn Leaping Over a Rainbow Between Two Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute unicorn leaping over a rainbow between two clouds, with bent front legs, a flowing mane, and outlined stars around it. Long curved hair sections and broad rainbow bands provide large coloring areas, while the spiral horn and small stars add details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Winged Unicorn Flying Above Fluffy Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute winged unicorn flies above fluffy clouds in this printable coloring page, spreading feathered wings while its curled mane and long tail sweep around the body. Layered feather shapes create many enclosed sections on the coloring sheet, alongside the striped horn, rounded hooves, and broad cloud banks below the flying figure.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Watching a Butterfly Resting on Its Nose Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a cute unicorn watching a butterfly resting on its nose, standing in a flowered meadow with a long wavy mane and tail. The butterfly's divided wings and curled antennae add delicate details near the face, while the coloring sheet provides broad body areas and small flowers below.

pages.title: Cute Princess Unicorn Wearing a Tiara and Royal Cape Beside a Castle Gate Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute princess unicorn wearing a tiara and royal cape beside a castle gate, with a heart-shaped jewel above the flowing mane. The cape fastens with an oval brooch, while the coloring sheet includes turret flags, stone blocks, heart decorations on the doors, and scattered paving stones.

pages.title: Cute Mermaid Unicorn Swimming Among Seashells and Small Fish Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute mermaid unicorn swims among seashells and small fish in this printable coloring page, with a flower in its mane and a long scaled tail below. Bubbles surround the figure, and the coloring sheet offers overlapping scales, striped fish, seaweed blades, shell ridges, and a small starfish along the seabed.

pages.title: Cute Cat Unicorn Playing with a Ball of Yarn Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a cute cat unicorn playing with a ball of yarn, resting one front paw on the large tangled ball beside a loose strand. A striped horn, wavy mane, whiskers, and fluffy upright tail combine cat and unicorn features, while the rug and yarn loops divide the coloring sheet into curved sections.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Cuddling a Teddy Bear Between Its Front Legs Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute unicorn cuddling a teddy bear between its front legs, seated with a tilted head and long curled hair around the toy. The bear's bow tie, round paw pads, and small facial features add enclosed details, while heart and star markings decorate the unicorn's flank on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Wearing a Party Hat Beside a Birthday Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute unicorn wears a party hat beside a birthday cake in this printable coloring page, surrounded by balloons and ribbon-tied gifts behind the three lit candles. The cake sits on a pedestal stand, and the coloring sheet includes dripping icing, round cake decorations, hat stripes, and star markings beside the flowing tail.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Nibbling a Cupcake with Swirled Frosting Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute unicorn nibbling a cupcake with swirled frosting, lowering its muzzle toward the tall topping on a plate in a grassy meadow. Small round sprinkles and the wrapper's vertical folds add detail, while the coloring sheet leaves broad spaces within the body, curls, and single heart marking.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Licking an Ice Cream Cone in a Cone Stand Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a cute unicorn licking an ice cream cone in a cone stand, reaching toward sprinkled scoops topped with a single cherry above it. The stand holds the crosshatched cone upright beside the unicorn, and the coloring sheet combines narrow waffle sections with broad mane curves and an open background.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Resting Beside a Stack of Sprinkle Donuts Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute unicorn rests beside a stack of sprinkle donuts in this printable coloring page, folding its legs on the grass beside three rings with dripping icing. A heart and two stars decorate the flank, while the coloring sheet offers small sprinkle shapes, donut holes, and long open sections within the mane and tail.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Blowing a Bubble Gum Bubble Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a cute unicorn blowing a bubble gum bubble, sitting upright on the grass with a large round bubble extending from its smiling muzzle. Two highlight shapes sit inside the bubble, and the coloring sheet adds flowing hair sections, a striped horn, small flowers, and low rounded bushes.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Eating a Strawberry Beside a Strawberry Plant Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute unicorn eating a strawberry beside a strawberry plant, holding the fruit at its mouth near serrated leaves and hanging berries. A small flower grows on the same plant, and the coloring sheet includes tiny seeds, leaf veins, flowing hair sections, and a simple fence behind the character.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Enjoying a Pizza Picnic on a Checkered Blanket Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute unicorn enjoys a pizza picnic on a checkered blanket in this printable coloring page, resting beside a sliced pizza and a separate portion on a plate. Mushroom shapes and round toppings divide the food into smaller areas, while the coloring sheet adds heart and star markings beside the unicorn's curled tail.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Wearing a Flower Crown with a Ribbon-braided Mane Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a cute unicorn wearing a flower crown with a ribbon-braided mane, standing with a long plait ending in a large bow beside its neck. Petals and pointed leaves frame the horn, while the coloring sheet alternates broad body shapes with interwoven hair sections, ribbon folds, and flowing tail curves.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Drinking From a Pond with Water Lilies Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute unicorn drinking from a pond with water lilies, bending its neck until the muzzle touches ripples near the grassy stone-lined bank. Two open blooms sit on large lily pads, and the coloring sheet adds layered petals, smooth rocks, water lines, and long sections within the hanging mane.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Watching Fireflies Beside a Mushroom Cottage Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute unicorn watches fireflies beside a mushroom cottage in this printable coloring page, looking upward at three winged insects with dotted flight trails above the spotted roof. The cottage has an arched door, small window, and chimney, adding straight and rounded details to the coloring sheet beside a stepping-stone path and flowers.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn and Bunny Sharing a Carrot in a Flower Patch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a cute unicorn and bunny sharing a carrot in a flower patch, each holding an opposite end between their mouths in the grass. Long rabbit ears and the unicorn's wavy mane frame the central carrot, while leafy tops, whiskers, and daisy-like blooms add fine details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Giving a Kitten a Ride on Its Back Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute unicorn giving a kitten a ride on its back, with the small passenger sitting upright and looking toward the unicorn's face. The kitten's curled tail, whiskers, and fluffy chest add fine details above the broad body, while long mane and tail sections sweep down the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Meeting a Fairy Perched on a Mushroom Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute unicorn meets a fairy perched on a mushroom in this printable coloring page, lowering its gaze toward the seated figure with pointed ears and patterned wings. The fairy wears a petal-shaped dress and a flower in a bun, adding small enclosed sections beside the spotted mushroom cap and surrounding blooms on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Little Girl Hugging a Cute Unicorn Around Its Neck Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a little girl hugging a cute unicorn around its neck, standing close as the unicorn bends its head toward her smiling face. The girl's dress has puffed sleeves, a scalloped hem, and a waist bow, while flowing hair and small meadow flowers create additional sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Carrying a Young Rider Along a Forest Path Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute unicorn carrying a young rider along a forest path, with the girl holding reins above a saddle and diamond-shaped chest ornament. Her boots rest in stirrups, and the coloring sheet adds bridle rings, dress folds, flowing hair, tree trunks, and scattered stones along the narrow trail.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Reading an Open Storybook on a Cushion Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute unicorn reads an open storybook on a cushion in this printable coloring page, leaning its front hooves toward the broad blank pages beneath an arched window. Tassels hang from the cushion, while stacked books and a heart-decorated pillow add simple shapes behind the character on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Wearing Round Glasses and a School Backpack Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a cute unicorn wearing round glasses and a school backpack, stepping forward with a lifted hoof and a long curled tail behind it. The backpack has a flap, side pocket, and square buckles, creating smaller sections beside the broad lenses, spiral horn, and wavy mane on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Playing a Piano with Its Front Hooves Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute unicorn playing a piano with its front hooves, seated on a stool beside a grand piano with its lid raised. Rows of keys, three pedals, and the lid prop provide straight-edged details, while the coloring sheet leaves broad open areas across the instrument and surrounding background.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Dancing Beneath a Disco Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute unicorn dances beneath a disco ball in this printable coloring page, lifting one front leg and tilting its head among outlined sparkle shapes around the mane. The ball's curved grid creates many small sections above the character, while the coloring sheet leaves the body and surrounding background broadly open.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Wearing Headphones at a Dj Turntable Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a cute unicorn wearing headphones at a DJ turntable, placing its front hooves near two records and a central panel of sliders and knobs. Concentric record grooves contrast with square controls, while the coloring sheet adds broad headphone cushions, a striped horn, and long curved mane sections above the table.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn in a Chef Hat and Apron Beside Freshly Baked Star Cookies Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute unicorn in a chef hat and apron beside freshly baked star cookies, standing at a kitchen table with a rectangular tray. The apron has scalloped trim and a heart pocket, while the coloring sheet adds a tail bow, an arched window, and shelves holding bowls and a pitcher.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Riding a Skateboard Down a Gentle Ramp Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute unicorn rides a skateboard down a gentle ramp in this printable coloring page, balancing with all four hooves on the long deck as its tail curls upward. Wheel rings and axle shapes form small mechanical details, while sweeping ramp lines and broad body areas keep the rest of the coloring sheet spacious.

pages.title: Cute Superhero Unicorn Wearing a Mask and Flowing Cape Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a cute superhero unicorn wearing a mask and flowing cape, standing on a grassy rise with a small turreted castle in the distance. The cape fastens at a round clasp and sweeps behind the mane, adding broad fabric sections beside outlined clouds and a winding path on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Sitting in a Large Teacup Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute unicorn sitting in a large teacup, resting its front hooves over the rim above a row of outlined heart decorations. A scalloped border wraps around the cup, while its curved handle and pedestal base create broad sections beneath the unicorn's mane and striped horn on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Looking Through a Telescope at a Shooting Star Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute unicorn looks through a telescope at a shooting star in this printable coloring page, standing beside a tall tripod beneath outlined stars and rounded clouds overhead. The telescope points toward the streaking star, and the coloring sheet includes circular lens rims, adjustment rings, tripod feet, and small flowers along the ground.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn with Butterfly Wings Resting on a Large Flower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a cute unicorn with butterfly wings resting on a large flower, folding its legs over the bloom's clustered center and broad layered petals. Oval spots and long divided panels decorate the wings, while the coloring sheet adds thin petal lines, a sturdy stem, and two large veined leaves below.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Unicorn Wearing a Santa Hat Beside a Decorated Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute Christmas unicorn wearing a Santa hat beside a decorated tree, with the striped horn emerging next to the fluffy hat brim. Round baubles and outlined stars fill the potted tree, while the coloring sheet offers long mane sections, a pompom, and broad open areas within the unicorn's body.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Pulling a Small Sleigh Filled with Wrapped Presents Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute unicorn pulls a small sleigh filled with wrapped presents in this printable coloring page, stepping through snow with harness straps and long shafts connecting to the sled. Large gift bows, dotted wrapping, and curled runners add enclosed details, while the coloring sheet places simple evergreen trees across rolling snowy hills behind the figure.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Wearing a Scarf Beside a Smiling Snowman Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a cute unicorn wearing a scarf beside a smiling snowman, with both figures standing in snow near simple evergreen trees behind them. The snowman has a top hat, carrot nose, twig arms, and three buttons, while striped scarves and fringed ends add smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Witch Unicorn Beside a Pumpkin and Bubbling Cauldron Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute witch unicorn beside a pumpkin and bubbling cauldron, wearing a wide pointed hat with a star attached to its band. A smiling jack-o'-lantern and rising bubbles frame the front legs, while the coloring sheet adds cauldron handles, curled pumpkin vines, and small star markings on the unicorn.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn in a Ghost Costume Carrying a Pumpkin Bucket Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute unicorn in a ghost costume carries a pumpkin bucket in this printable coloring page, holding the handle in its mouth beneath a large moon and clouds. The draped costume has openings for the face and horn, and the coloring sheet includes long fabric folds, a scalloped hem, and a picket fence behind it.

pages.title: Cute Easter Unicorn Wearing Bunny Ears Beside a Basket of Eggs Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a cute Easter unicorn wearing bunny ears beside a basket of eggs, with small flowers on the headband and a bow on the handle. Hearts, spots, stripes, and zigzags divide the eggs into patterned sections, while woven basket strips and long mane curls add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Valentine Unicorn Carrying a Heart Envelope in Its Mouth Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute Valentine unicorn carrying a heart envelope in its mouth, stepping along a grassy path with outlined hearts floating around the head. Three more hearts decorate the flank, while the coloring sheet includes triangular envelope folds, a large heart seal, and broad sections within the flowing mane and tail.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn in a Raincoat Splashing Through a Puddle Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute unicorn in a raincoat splashes through a puddle in this printable coloring page, lifting one front hoof as curved water drops rise around the ripple below. Large raindrops fill the background, and the coloring sheet adds coat buttons, a heart-shaped pocket design, rolled sleeve edges, and long curls in the exposed mane.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Floating in a Donut Swim Ring at a Pool Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a cute unicorn floating in a donut swim ring at a pool, resting its front hooves over the sprinkle-decorated inflatable beneath a sun. A ladder and umbrella stand along the pool edge, while wavy water lines and the ring's dripping icing pattern create curved sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Riding in a Hot Air Balloon Above the Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cute unicorn riding in a hot air balloon above the clouds, resting its front hooves over the rim of a woven basket. Heart ornaments and draped bands decorate the balloon, while narrow suspension ropes and basket panels add smaller sections beneath its broad curved canopy on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Taking a Bubble Bath with a Rubber Duck Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute unicorn takes a bubble bath with a rubber duck in this printable coloring page, resting its front hooves on a rounded tub overflowing with outlined foam. Floating bubbles surround the horn and mane, while the coloring sheet includes the duck's beak and wing, a small foam tuft, and decorative tub feet below.
